description: The Release 0 exit proof (BUILD-MAP-001 section (d), R0 exit gate): every Release 0 packet (the R0 rows of BUILD-MAP section (c)) with the apps/server suites its records name, the Release 0 manifests that bind each suite, issue #186's seven journey steps (section (b)), and an explanation for every skip and todo in those suites. apps/server/src/core/config/release0-proof-coverage.spec.ts checks it; `pnpm --filter server proof:release0` runs scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs over exactly `manifests`, then that spec.
derivation: A packet's suites are, from its own records: (1) the apps/server suites in its BUILD-QUEUE-001.json tests_first; (2) the suites its branch created (git log --diff-filter=A of pkt/<id>, its -repair, the pre-queue branch BUILD-MAP names for it: R0-05 = R0-AB-04, R0-15 = R0-CT-05, R0-17 = R0-PL-03, R0-03 = R0-CT-03, R0-04 = R0-PC-01, R0-11 = R0-PL-07, R0-20 = R0-PL-04; and the R0 follow-ups that landed under it: lettered ids R0-07a, R0-08c, R0-09b..g, R0-13b..g, R0-34b, and the families R0-ID-F* and R0-F24 under R0-05, R0-SEC-01/02 under R0-14, R0-SEC-03/04 under R0-32, R0-CMF1/2 under R0-11, R0-CMF3 under R0-04, R0-CMF4..6 under R0-07, R0-SEC2* under R0-09 (D-11), R0-D1..D7 and R0-QI-01 under R0-16 via release0-landed.json); (3) every suite a manifest with an R0 packageId binds, listed under the packet that packageId names.

A suite an R0 branch only edited, created before the queue or by a V1 packet, stays with its creator and is listed in editedOnly (it is not a Release 0 suite). A queue tests_first suite that never existed is listed in queueSuitesLandedAs with the suite that carries its proof.

The Release 0 manifests are every manifest whose packageId starts with 'R0-' (R0-35 added one per packet whose suites no manifest bound, packageId 'R0-35-EXIT-PROOF:<packet>', every passing case required) plus k12-self.json (R0-16 extends it).

steps.title: Register or log in securely; create or select a business; tenant isolation
Create and issue an invoice or quote
Record an offline/manual payment safely and idempotently, with a correct balance and audit trail
Inspect contacts, invoices and payments in the UI; refresh without data loss
A user without rights cannot read or modify another tenant's objects
No unapproved paid external API; optional services fail visibly
